data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal sprite strip containing exactly 6 separate animation frames arranged left-to-right in one row for the Codex app digital pet "tracebun" in the idle state. Use the attached base pet image and reference image(s) as the canonical identity. Preserve the exact same rabbit character design across all frames: compact observability guardian rabbit inspired by SanguiShop, warm brown and cream palette, sturdy chibi silhouette, thick dark outline, small floppy ears, calm focused eyes, tiny service badge on the chest, reliable engineer energy, same head shape, facial markings, body proportions, prop/accessory design, and overall silhouette. Do not redesign the pet.

Animation direction: subtle idle only. Show gentle breathing, tiny ear twitch, slight body bob, minimal blink variation, and tiny hand/paw shifts if needed. Keep each frame recognizably the same pet and keep motion very small and natural.

Critical output constraints: the final image must contain ONLY the 6 sprite frames and the pet artwork. No layout guide, no guide background, no white, no off-white, no gray, no borders, no boxes, no center marks, no labels, no spacing lines, no extra margins, and no visible artifacts from the planning guide. Use a fully transparent background if supported; otherwise a clean solid transparent-like empty background with no visible color blocks. Ensure the strip reads as a clean game sprite sheet with the pet centered in each frame and consistent spacing.

Style: crisp pixel-art / clean sprite style, matching the provided base image, with clean edges and consistent outline weight. The strip should be ready for game use.
